values.quote: '''Lulu''' sends ''{{ai|Pix, Faerie Companion|Lulu|Pix}}'' to the target ally for {{fd|6.25}} seconds
values.binNote: Wiki text states 6.25 seconds but bin LuluE.PixOnAllyDuration = 6; disagreement between sources.

values.meaning: Pix / reveal duration on enemy cast
values.quote: '''Lulu''' sends ''{{ai|Pix, Faerie Companion|Lulu|Pix}}'' to the far side of the target enemy for 4 seconds

mechanics.claim: Casting on an enemy deals magic damage and reveals them for the duration.
mechanics.quote: dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them for the same duration

mechanics.claim: Casting on an ally or self only shields champions, not other unit types.
mechanics.quote: If the target is a {{tip|champion}}, they are granted a {{tip|shield}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds.

mechanics.claim: Spell shield and Riposte block the damage but Pix still follows the target.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|spell shield|Spell shield}} and {{ai|Riposte|Fiora}} will block the damage but '''Pix''' will still follow regardless.
